item.title: Warmest weather in weeks showing up
item.description: After a cold Wednesday, temperatures will rise into the 50s and 60s by the weekend, with 70° highs possible on Monday and mild February weather continuing through the week.

item.title: Why This Missouri State Professor Is Racing to Preserve Black History
item.description: The African American Heritage Trail in Springfield, Missouri is being used to preserve and highlight the city's African American history, which is often overlooked, through the use of markers and stories passed down through oral tradition.

item.title: City Council to consider petition to improve North Glenstone
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — The Springfield City Council is considering the creation of a community improvement district to fund enhancements along a portion of North Glenstone. The proposed plan would establish an additional 1% district sales tax to pay for area maintenance, security and beautification efforts. This would bring the total tax to 9.1%. The district [...]

item.title: Fort Leonard Wood soldier found guilty in death of Sergeant
item.description: Specialist Wooster Rancy was found guilty of murder for the death of Sergeant Sarah Roque at Fort Leonard Wood in 2024.

item.title: City of Branson shuts down 76 Family Inn
item.description: The City of Branson used its emergency power to vacate the 76 Family Inn last week after it was determined to be unsafe to be occupied, and is coordinating with community partners to provide support to those impacted.
